pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/python-runner.ts:86 The runtime separates pure decisions (interpreter resolution with an injected probe, the cache policy, argv builders) from the spawn and DB edges, so each decision is unit-testable without Python or a DB.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/python-runner.ts:89 The interpreter probe is injected and the runtime wires spawnSync in at the edge. PYTHON_CMD is the outside enabling point the spawn tests use (node stands in).
app/_lib/reasoning-cache-policy.ts:1 The cache policy is a pure predicate kept apart from storage.
app/_lib/python-runner.ts:861 One call hides the workdir lifecycle, input file writing, spawn, exit-code mapping and cleanup. timeoutMs is required, so a missing deadline is a type error.
app/_lib/python-runner.ts:878 The one unchecked cast is labelled at the boundary, kept to a single line, and has an optional guard.
app/_lib/llm-request-context.ts:61 AsyncLocalStorage carries only per-branch identifiers into the child env. Accumulated spend comes back through the ledger sidecar, not through a copied struct.
app/_lib/llm-request-context.ts:11 Explicitly trades parameter threading across ~20 modules for plumbing at the two ends that care.
app/_lib/pull-pass.ts:201 Serial on purpose and bounded per source. pullOneSource never throws, so the flow-control choice stays in the driver.
app/_lib/pull-pass.ts:204 One pass builds several tallies plus the outcome list, which is the multiple-outputs case where explicit sequential code is the right form.

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/llm/base.py:502 TextProvider.complete fuses the retry/deadline policy with the wall clock, sleep, randomness and monitor emission, so test_llm_base.py has to patch base.time.monotonic, base.time.sleep, base.random.uniform and base.monitor to exercise one deadline branch, which is the many-doubles symptom io-free-core names.

techniques.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/llm/base.py:539 The retry policy is logic over events, yet time and jitter are read from the environment rather than passed in or injected. Tests patch module globals instead.
pipeline/jobfit/llm/base.py:261 One-verb provider seam. Production adapters and test fakes are both subclasses of TextProvider.
pipeline/jobfit/llm/base.py:264 Shared behaviour sits behind a small available/complete/complete_json/map surface.
pipeline/jobfit/llm/adapters/qwen.py:21 Inheritance adds a capability (endpoint and key env) and is not there to make a distinction, so inheriting the OpenAI surface is the benign case.
pipeline/jobfit/llm/base.py:704 The fan-out is the batch rule itself (map) and stays confined to one method.
pipeline/jobfit/llm/base.py:499 The retry loop has effects and early exits, so an explicit loop is the correct form.

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBoardMove.ts:58 mergeMovedRow is exported and accepts Partial<Entry>, so the guarantee that stage is a string lives in moveOutcome (line 35) only by convention. A caller that skips moveOutcome writes undefined into the column key, the exact failure the module documents. The checker could prove this if the `applied` variant carried `stage: string`.

techniques.evidence: app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBoardMove.ts:52 The cast is unmarked, and the checked surface encloses it by convention only, even though a typed alternative costs almost nothing.
app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBoardFilters.ts:151 Time is a parameter. Move, filter, layout and confirm decisions are pure modules driven by hooks.
app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBulkConfirm.ts:83 Explicit single-slot state with a total switch, the recommended shape for a state machine.

app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBoardStorage.ts:53 Storage is injected so the cross-tenant invariant is tested without a DOM. The interface copies Storage's verbs, acceptable because it exists for testing, not replacement.
app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBulkConfirm.ts:60 Hides the scope/cohort stamping from children, so callers learn less.
app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBulkConfirm.ts:34 Disarm-by-derivation puts a whole change class (new filter mutators) in one place.
app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBoardMove.ts:11 The async fetch stays in the hook and the move decision is synchronous.
